block_evidence: Atomic Relaxed increment provides per-wrapper IDs; not memory publication. Constructors own inputs before Send/static closure capture. Detached/scoped helpers allocate descriptor Compute/CancelOnDrop and one Arc<Mutex<Option<Result>>>; scope failure propagates before wrapper creation.

run_loader checks/acknowledges cancellation before loading; after successful loader checks token before expensive preparation; all loader errors remain business results. It locks result before final cancellation acknowledgement and either drops prepared result or publishes once. Cancellation cannot forcibly interrupt filesystem/project parsing in loader; suppresses later publication. acknowledge_if_cancelled returns observed flag and debug-asserts successful token acknowledgement.

rejected prepopulates admission error in completed task; no loader runs. Harness scheduler helper borrows process-default compute pool. Running cancel test rendezvous blocks loader, requests cancellation while Running, releases then expects Cancelled and cancelled result. Delay matrix 0/10/1000ms checks successful one-time publication and ResultUnavailable on repeat take. Scoped test blocks worker, closes admission before queued loader, drains/shuts runtime, asserts loader signal absent and Cancelled.

task.rs request_cancel and run_loader share result mutex; PreparedDynamicSceneSpawn::new_with_limit checks schema and estimated payload; JSON loader uses versioned read; path loader translates filesystem read failure to Io with path.
